prompts.prompt:
Use case: final promotional website banner redesign. Reference image 1 is a COMPOSITION AND ART-DIRECTION reference, not a source for its text, logos or character identity. Redesign the PinoyPlay ₱20 Welcome Bonus campaign using its editorial anime character-poster composition. Output one wide landscape banner with aspect ratio 1882:836, approximately 2.25:1, full bleed and no outer mockup.

COMPOSITION: follow the reference's central seated character overlapping gigantic typography behind her, blue upper field flowing into an ivory lower field, layered low-opacity character silhouette / illustrative line art in the backdrop, one flowing pale white ornamental shape behind the central figure, and a few clean slanted white information labels. The background must feel like ONE continuous richly layered image, not separate panels, no vertical seams. Color palette predominantly refined cobalt and deep Pinoy navy blue, white and a few restrained Pinoy red accents. Fine halftone dots and subtle graphic grain; stylish magazine/anime launch poster, striking but uncluttered. No gift box. No money coins, no rooster, no slot machine.

CHARACTER: one original clearly adult fantasy woman, approximately 25 years old, beautiful polished anime illustration with blue eyes and long flowing silver-blonde hair with pale turquoise highlights. She sits elegantly on a minimal tall navy chair in the middle at about x=55%, head near top and the boots/chair near bottom. Confident welcoming expression facing the viewer. Sophisticated layered navy and white fantasy coat-dress with silver trim, high neckline, fitted sleeves, dark opaque tights and elegant tall boots; fully clothed, nonsexual editorial pose with crossed legs. Intricate fabric shading and lovely flowing hair, clear silhouette. She should overlap the giant lettering to establish foreground/background depth, as in the reference. No exact copy of the reference character, no game-specific crest, no horns or weapons needed.

TYPOGRAPHY & HIERARCHY: preserve the welcome bonus offer. On the left foreground, huge bold condensed white / ice-white "₱20" with crisp navy shadow, taking about one third of canvas width and half its height; ensure completely readable, unobstructed by the character. Above it on the upper-left is clearly legible condensed bold "WELCOME BONUS" in white, with a small restrained red tag "NEW PLAYER EXCLUSIVE". Across the middle/lower background, running edge-to-edge behind the character, gigantic condensed uppercase "WELCOME" as an editorial typographic backdrop, similar in scale to the reference's huge name. It may be partly occluded by the figure, but the clear headline and amount on the left must remain readable. Use two angled white tags with navy lettering near the character at upper-right and lower-right: "REGISTER" and "AUTO CREDIT". Keep the image sparse and legible at mobile banner size, omit long paragraphs, avoid tiny thumbnails/collage strips. Lower-left small navy footnote: "Deposit required to play · 5× Slot wagering". Philippine peso sign must be ₱, not dollar. No other text. No company logo, no reference game logo or names, no artist signature, no social media icons, no watermark, no CTA button. Keep 4% safe margin around actual offer text and leave bottom-right carousel tray area clear. Premium professional finish.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise character replacement in a finished promotional banner. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the blue-and-white ₱20 Welcome Bonus editorial banner. Image 2 and image 3 are official CHARACTER IDENTITY references for Cass, the adult female cowgirl from PG Soft Wild Bounty Showdown. Replace the central silver-haired fantasy woman in image 1 with CASS from images 2 and 3. Preserve the overall seated, legs-crossed pose, position, visual scale, central chair, and the banner's exact blue-and-white typographic composition. User specifically requires a SITTING POSE WITH ONE LEG CROSSED OVER THE OTHER AT THE KNEE. Show her full figure and boots, body comfortably seated, natural anatomy, both legs clearly readable, one boot raised by the crossed knee and the other boot closer to the floor.

Preserve Cass's recognizable identity from references: confident adult female face, blue eyes, warm golden-brown/blonde shoulder-length wavy hair, light cream cowboy hat with a gold sheriff star and brown hatband, purple patterned paisley waistcoat/vest over a light pink collared shirt, cream/ivory trousers, brown leather belt and holster with brass buckle, brown leather gloves and western boots. Fully clothed stylized 3D game-character illustration consistent with the official character's face and rendering quality, polished not photorealistic. Do not convert her into an anime silver-haired character, do not change her into a different person, do not use a dress. Do not hold or aim a gun; hands may rest elegantly on the chair and near her hat. Purple vest and cream pants must remain her original clothing colors even though the campaign background is blue. Replace the faint ghosted portrait in the blue background with a subtle low-opacity portrait of this same cowboy-hatted Cass so the background remains coherent. The pale ornamental silhouette behind her can become a clean flowing white western-poster graphic halo, not huge fantasy hair.

CHANGE ONLY the main figure, the faint background portrait and the immediate character shadow/halo needed to fit her. KEEP the finished banner's exact horizontal 1882:836 layout, refined cobalt/navy/white palette with small red accents, continuous full-bleed layered backdrop, typography style, huge ₱20 on the left, oversized WELCOME lettering behind the seated figure, tilted white labels, spacing, sizes and positions. Preserve all existing English text EXACTLY, with no additions or misspellings: "NEW PLAYER EXCLUSIVE", "WELCOME BONUS", "₱20", giant background "WELCOME", angled tags "REGISTER" and "AUTO CREDIT", lower-left footnote "Deposit required to play · 5× Slot wagering". Keep the full ₱20 unobstructed and legible. No Wild Bounty Showdown game logo, no PG logo, no PinoyPlay logo, no gold coins, no gift box, no rooster, no extra characters, no watermark or artist signature. Keep the full original banner dimensions and don't crop away any text.
